title: Player NBT Editor
description: This plugin allows you to edit special NBT data of players to change values like max hearts.
body:
# PlayerNBTEditor

PlayerNBTEditor is a lightweight plugin that allows server operators to modify player NBT data directly from in-game commands.

Instead of stopping the server and editing player files with external tools like NBTExplorer, you can quickly change values while the server is running.

## Features

- Edit player NBT data using commands
- Modify player inventories
- Edit player ender chests
- Works with online players
- Simple and lightweight
- No dependencies
- Designed for server administrators

## Command

/nbt <action> <amount> <player>

## Permissions

Commands require OP.

## Use Cases

- Fixing bugged inventories
- Clearing or adjusting player items
- Editing ender chest contents
- Testing mechanics that rely on NBT
- Correcting broken player data without opening external tools

## Warning

Editing NBT can break things if used incorrectly.

It is recommended to make backups before modifying important player data.
